name: The Saga of the Candy Scroll
summary:
The text intro presented at the start of the game:

"This is a game made in two days for #candyjam. Enjoy!"

A puzzle game about lining up candy gems, inspired by match-3 games but playing more like a top-down grid-based puzzle game.

Cover taken from the freeindiegam.es page. Exact release date is unknown but presumably was posted some time in early 2014 when the Candy Jam was held.
